bug_info.bug_desc: Signed-division preprocessing feeds `{~op_a_i, 1'b0}` to the leading-zero counter for a negative dividend. For `op_a_i = -1`, that expression becomes an all-zero input, taking the wrong normalization path and producing quotient 0 and remainder -1 for `-1 / 1`.
bug_info.fix_hint: Handle the signed `-1` dividend explicitly in the LZC input encoding so it is represented as a nonzero magnitude while preserving the existing preprocessing for other negative operands.
